cells.label: fact

items.text: Merrill executives in October 2026 said recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm returned to veteran broker recruiting, having largely pulled back from it at the end of 2017 before Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf restored a focus on hiring.
items.quote: Merrill executives in October touted that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm has returned to veteran broker recruiting. The firm largely pulled back from veteran broker recruiting at the end of 2017 but returned after Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf, who took over in 2023, restored a focus on hiring

items.text: Merrill reported the largest net losses among advisors this year through August 13, 2026, at 552, according to Wolfe Research.
items.quote: The firm has reportedly seen the largest net losses among advisors this year through Aug. 13 at 552, according to the most recent data from Wolfe Research

items.text: Merrill Lynch created new data analytics fees (between $125,000 and $860,000 per firm per year for actively managed products) and a revenue-sharing 'support fee' of up to 0.1% of assets, effective January 1, 2027, for third-party asset managers.
items.quote: Merrill's new data analytics fees will cost asset managers between $125,000 and $860,000 per-firm, per-year ... effective, Jan. 1, 2027

items.text: Merrill agreed to pay $39 million to settle a class action lawsuit alleging it paid brokerage clients close-to-zero interest rates instead of market rates on cash in retirement accounts, on top of a prior $25 million SEC penalty.
items.quote: the Thundering Herd agreeing this week to pay $39 million to settle a class action lawsuit that alleged it paid brokerage clients close-to-zero interest rates instead of market rates on cash in retirement accounts

items.text: Merrill Lynch faces restitution of approximately $549,000 in excess commissions as part of a combined $4.4 million settlement with state securities regulators over unreasonable commissions on small-dollar retail equity transactions.
items.quote: Merrill Lynch faces restitution on approximately $549,000 in excess commissions over the same period, NASAA said

items.text: Merrill launched Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA), new services combining automation with portfolio oversight to help clients simplify asset transitions and cash deployment.
items.quote: Merrill today announced the launch of Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA), new services that combine automation with professional portfolio oversight

items.text: Merrill Lynch client sales of alternative investments increased 19% in the third quarter of 2026, according to Eric Schimpf, president and co-head of Merrill Wealth Management.
items.quote: At Merrill Lynch, client sales of alternative investments increased 19% in the quarter, said Eric Schimpf, president and co-head of Merrill Wealth Management
items.unit: percent increase in alternative investment sales
